title: Rav Zevid, Father of Rabbi Shimon bar Zevid
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Berakhot 38a the Rabbis praised to Rabbi Zeira the son of Rav Zevid, the brother of Rabbi Shimon bar Zevid. Hyman regards the reading cited in Dikdukei Soferim as straightforward and true, proposing “Rav Zevid, the father of Rabbi Shimon bar Zevid, for he is a great man and expert in blessings.” He said to them: “When he comes into your hands, bring him to me.” Once he came to him … he said, “Is this the one of whom they say he is a great man?” etc.

notes.text: Hyman quotes Shimon as the brother’s name; the saved Davidson Berakhot 38a reads Shmuel bar Rav Zevid. The father-of emendation and evaluation as a true reading remain Hyman’s report, not an automatic genealogy change.
